resolvedContracts: P5 owns semantic run governance before the P3/P4 execution boundary
P3 remains canonical for AgentRun state and ApprovalRequest state
P4 remains canonical for machine identity, worker transport, tenant grants, capabilities, lease, local repository mapping, and Codex runtime
Each run records exact configuration references
Context is minimum sufficient, tenant-scoped, hashed, and versioned
Tool permission is deny-by-default and cannot bypass human approval
AI output remains proposal state until an authorized transition
ownerResolvedContracts: AgentDefinition is stable semantic identity and published AgentDefinitionVersion is immutable execution identity
One immutable AgentRoleVersion binds each Run; P5 V1 has no role inheritance or composition
Permission compilation is deny-by-default intersection with an authenticated initiator authority ceiling
ContextPackage is an immutable exact-scope snapshot with explicit descendant aggregation and no raw secrets
Instruction precedence is fixed and retrieved context and tool output are data only
Every Run has a concrete monotonic RunBudget and nested Runs are prohibited
Retries and approval resumes reuse immutable artifacts and fail closed on restrictive policy or revoked authority
